Do not execute the launcher, change PATH, run F3, modify candidate bytes, stage or commit. No prepare, resume, regeneration, installation, transfer, publication, fetch or push.

## R1 — Make child failure fail the launcher

Overall success must require:
- child exit code 0;
- no termination signal;
- no spawn error;
- all binding and preservation checks passing.

A nonzero exit, null exit status, signal or spawn error must produce a nonzero launcher exit. Record the child result separately. Never convert a failed or unstarted F3 review into success because protected files stayed unchanged.

## R2 — Use one controlled environment

Construct one final child environment with:
- exactly one case-insensitive PATH key;
- the frozen Git directory first;
- the remaining permitted PATH entries in their existing order;
- the operative guard’s sanitization applied.

Use that same final environment for executable resolution, version/configuration queries, bindingFindings, snapshots, child launch and every review subprocess.

Do not validate with sanitized `genv` and launch with unsanitized `env`. Leave the parent environment, user/machine PATH, profiles and Git configuration unchanged.

## R3 — Preserve failure evidence and protect output locations

Before any write:
- require a new, absolute output destination inside the fresh external review packet;
- validate its resolved path;
- reject destinations inside the repository, work/candidate tree, live graph, frozen stray work or an existing sealed packet;
- reject link/reparse substitutions.

Add structured error handling and finalization covering imports, reads, parsing, executable queries, snapshots and child execution.

Retain the original error, phase, child status and any secondary finalization error. Attempt after-state verification when possible; record unavailable proof explicitly. Never replace the original failure with a logging error or mark missing evidence as success.

Keep result/log writes outside protected locations. Ensure final result writing cannot alter candidate bytes after the preservation comparison.

## PowerShell invocation

Provide a valid PowerShell command using the call operator, for example:

& 'C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe' '<absolute revised launcher>' --child '<absolute fresh review script>' --out '<absolute new external output folder>'

Quote paths correctly. Do not claim one syntax works in every shell. If another shell is supported, give it a separately labelled invocation.

Clearly identify the child script and output path that must be fixed and reviewed before execution release. Any remaining placeholder is incomplete execution DoR.
